recommendation: Keep the source change as-is. It completes the template-side part of the accepted FHIR-24911 clarification in the current FHIR checkout, while source/profiling.html already satisfies the core narrative portion.
issue_request: FHIR-24911 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core R5 clarification requesting that the Presenting Profiles snapshot tab documentation state that inherited invariants/constraints are omitted. The accepted resolution said to add the clarification in both the core spec and the standard IG template.
initial_application: Historical commit ab57a6ec6612843e82bb7d09a22b50f38e266464 applied the core narrative part by changing source/profiling.html so Full Structure says the view is comprehensive though inherited constraints are not presented. That application did not touch tools/templates/template-profile.html, whose generated snapshot/full-structure paragraphs still lacked the caveat.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2020-03-23 confirm the 7-0-0 decision to add the clarification to both core spec and IG template. The originating Zulip thread shows this was about rendered profile tables hiding inherited constraints to avoid overwhelming the display, not about removing constraints from StructureDefinition snapshots.
reconciliation: Updated tools/templates/template-profile.html so both the Full Structure tab and the All view snapshot paragraph state that inherited constraints are not presented in the rendered view.
source_changes: tools/templates/template-profile.html: Added 'Inherited constraints are not presented in this view.' to both generated snapshot/full-structure description paragraphs.
